purpose: Common pilot and training benchmark for Lumen, CathSim, and stEVE/SOFA-style endovascular RL environments.

source_protocols.name: CathSim
source_protocols.paper: CathSim: An Open-source Simulator for Endovascular Intervention

source_protocols.name: stEVE_bench
source_protocols.paper: Learning-Based Autonomous Navigation, Benchmark Environments and Simulation Framework for Endovascular Interventions

comparison_method: Compare matched task classes without claiming identical geometry or safety semantics. Every result identifies its native environment, task, policy, seed schedule, episode count, endpoint, and deviations.

pilot_budget.purpose: Verify executable adapters and directional baseline metrics before spending multi-day RL compute.

main_budget.purpose: Preregistered PPO/SAC self-assessment across matched task classes.

lumen.value: maximum device-surface overlap in simulator length units
lumen.pressure_curve: per-step wall pressure proxy in simulator units
lumen.impulse_curve: cumulative wall-load impulse in simulator units times seconds

cathsim.value: maximum reported contact force in CathSim native units

calibration.cross_environment_safety_claim: prohibited until a matched-device, matched-anatomy/material, solver-unit, and physical force-injury calibration is supplied
required_evidence: matched device-tip geometry and insertion protocol
phantom or ex-vivo force, pressure, and impulse traces
predeclared risk mapping and uncertainty analysis

native_endpoint_metrics.aggregation: within_environment_only; never rank or average across endpoint names

preregistration.rule: Publish every preregistered run, including null, unfavorable, failed, and blocked outcomes.
preregistration.historical_artifacts: Existing results retain their original schema and must not be silently reinterpreted under this contract.

known_deviations: Pilot policies are not trained agents and cannot support claims about final RL control quality.
Native geometries differ across environments; comparison is by matched task class and metric contract.
stEVE/SOFA requires SOFA, SofaPython3, and BeamAdapter; executable status must be recorded separately from Lumen/CathSim.
No cross-environment safety rate is reported until the calibration evidence listed above exists.
